question: Define free market economy (Extract C line 17).
answer: Prices for goods and services emerge from the interaction of demand and supply.

criteria.description:
MARK SCHEME – INTERNATIONAL AS ECONOMICS – EC01 – JANUARY 2024 
11 
Section B  
Total for this section:  65 marks 
 
Question Part Marking guidance 
Total 
marks 
16 
1 
Define ‘free market economy’ (Extract C, line 17). 
 
A full and precise definition is given (3 marks) 
 
Examples: 
• where decisions about what to produce, how to produce it and who 
should benefit are taken by buyers and sellers, (with no 
involvement by government) 
• where prices of goods and services are determined by the 
interaction of demand and supply (price mechanism). 
• where resource allocation depends on sellers and people’s 
preferences  
 
The substantive content of the definition is correct, but there 
may be some imprecision or inaccuracy (2 marks) 
 
Examples: 
• where demand and supply determine what is produced 
• where resource allocation depends on people’s preferences. 
 
Fragmented points only (1 mark) 
 
Examples:  
• no government involvement/intervention 
• capitalist or laissez-faire economy. 
 
3 
 
AO1 = 3

Define ‘imperfect information’ (Extract B, line 6). 
 
A full and precise definition is given (3 marks) 
 
Examples: 
• when buyers and/or sellers do not have all the necessary 
information (to make the correct decision about a product) 
• incomplete and inaccurate information.

• not having all the information 
• incorrect information 
• where the buyer has more information than the seller (or vice

•  incomplete or inaccurate information

• where the information is difficult to understand/process 
• a type of information failure.
